notes: Model tags churn quickly. Re-verify against 'ollama search' / the Ollama library before trusting sizes.
size_gb is a historical planning estimate in decimal GB, not a pinned artifact size. Check /api/tags for installed bytes; library pages and registry/backend variants may differ.
Resident memory also includes KV cache, compute buffers, and backend-specific overhead. Download size alone is not a fit test.
Most standard entries are GGUF/Q4_K_M; gpt-oss:20b is GGUF/MXFP4. The listed MLX alternatives are safetensors/NVFP4 and may have different sizes and runtime requirements.
Tier membership is cumulative in intent: 'recommended' includes the 'minimal' model, 'full' includes everything.

ram_budget.rationale: ~8GB for macOS and background daemons, ~4GB for apps/browser, remainder reserved for KV cache at long agent context.

models.name: gemma4-e4b
models.summary: Tiny but genuinely usable. The 'airplane' model: loads fast, leaves headroom for everything else.

models.name: qwen3-coder-30b
models.summary: MoE with only ~3B active parameters, so it runs far faster than its 30B label suggests. The safe default daily driver.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.summary: OpenAI open-weight model. Strong, reliable tool-calling - the best first pick when an agent harness misbehaves.

models.name: qwen3.6-27b-coding
models.summary: Coding-tuned variant of the Qwen 3.6 generation.

models.name: devstral-small-2-24b
models.summary: Purpose-built for agentic loops (plan / call tool / observe / repeat) rather than single-shot completion.

models.name: qwen3.8-27b
models.summary: Newest Qwen generation. Best general reasoning in the set that still fits comfortably.

models.name: gemma4-26b
models.summary: Google's multimodal model - accepts images as well as text.
